domains.comments: All 6 capabilities reviewed; conflicts and open questions resolved

conflictsResolution.resolution: 60 minutes is correct; the code (config.py:15, statuses/service.py:117-118, tests) reflects intended behaviour. README.md:24 and the 2026-10-01 decision record are wrong and must be updated to 60. ADR-001-edit-window.md is malformed (mis-captured heredoc) and must be repaired/superseded with a decision recording 60 minutes. BR-009 (30 min) is retired; BR-010 (60 min) stands as STATED. Owner: BA / Product.

Remove. minidon/lists/ is confirmed dead code (unreachable, tables never created, no tests) and is excluded from the baseline. Schedule its deletion as a follow-up change. If user-curated lists are wanted later, they will be specified and built as a new capability. Closes OQ-020 and OQ-021. Owner: BA / Product.

Leave as a plain import. social/queries.py is not formalised as a shared-kernel contract for now; the current coupling (5 of 6 capabilities) is accepted. It remains owned by L1-following. Revisit if visibility semantics change. Closes OQ-005. Owner: BA / Product / Domain modelling.

Formalise. accounts/service.py#get_by_username is designated a stable identity-resolution API owned by L1-accounts. Its signature and behaviour are a cross-capability contract; changes require review by consuming capabilities (following, posting, timelines, moderation). Document the contract as a follow-up. Closes OQ-018. Owner: Tech Lead.

Keep one capability. L1-posting stays a single capability with two L2 sub-capabilities (status-composition, status-interactions), matching the single statuses/ package. README's Posting and Interacting sections map to those L2s. Closes OQ-019. Owner: BA / Product.

Accept. Moderation calling statuses/service.py#soft_delete directly is accepted, and the cascading boost deletion is intended behaviour when staff delete a reported status. Update moderation docs (BR-015) to state the cascade explicitly. No narrower API for now. Closes OQ-017. Owner: Tech Lead / BA Product.

Code is correct. Boosting is restricted to public and unlisted statuses (BOOSTABLE frozenset); followers-only and direct statuses are not boostable, to avoid rebroadcasting beyond the author's chosen audience. README.md:28 must be updated to state the restriction. Closes OQ-008. Owner: BA / Product.
